text.tspan: 1 · Prepare an execution independently of ordinary requests
2 · Deliver immutable material, probe, then select serving
Bootstrap mechanism remains an owner decision.
A ready or bound candidate is not yet serving.
3 · Admit the authentic personal request or team mention
4 · Verify the actual request before repository effects and output
[Same proof and original authority remain current]
Requested stop, observed stop, local closure, and provider settlement differ.
Timeout retains unsettled custody. Already accepted effects may complete.
Measure both receiving withdrawal endpoints within the original 30-second budget.

svg.text: Admit immutable revision and pending assignment
Prepare private ingress and protected key custody
Session outcome and new material if created
Run protected probe under separate bootstrap purpose
Hand off the authentic invocation to its turn
Resolve serving and exact current repository authority
Synchronously refuse new work and protected bytes
Request stop and observe exact incarnation
